Settings

Choose when a droid you don't currently need counts as “sell early.”

Red “sell early” starts at rebirth
21

A droid you won't need again until rebirth 21 or later shows a red outline — safe to sell now and re-pull for the endgame. Needed again before rebirth 21 → no outline, so keep it. In the full chart, rebirth numbers from 21 on are shown in red to mark the block.

Upgrade chip costs & legend

Cell outline: sell after this rebirth sell, needed again at rebirth 21+ keep

◆ crystals earned at that rebirth — the reward starts at Rebirth 12.

↺ small numbers on a tile are later rebirths that also need it, coloured by the rarity required then.

✓ tap a droid tile to mark it owned at that rarity: that tile and every lower-rarity tile of the same droid dim. Tap a higher rarity to include it too; tap a dimmed tile to give it back.

Press and hold a tile (or right-click on desktop) to pick the exact rarity you own from a list — handy when it isn't the tile on screen.

SELL — not required again anywhere in this cycle.

SELL, but needed again — safe to sell now, but the chart asks for it again at Rebirth 21 or later. Adjust this cutoff with the settings ⚙ cog.

KEEP — required again before Rebirth 21, so hold on to it.

✦ NEW — the first rebirth this cycle that needs a droid: a fresh pull or build. On the chart it shows as a cyan dot.

↺ Rn — you were already asked for this droid at Rebirth n, so you should own it — this rebirth just upgrades its rarity.

Verdicts are worked out from the chart itself, not copied from the poster banners, so they stay correct at whatever rebirth you are on.
